blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu Province’s proposed ₱14.6-billion budget for 2027 is expected to be referred to the Sangguniang Panlalawigan’s (SP) Committee on Budget and Appropriations next week, paving the way for a detailed review of the proposed allocations. Vice Governor Glenn Soco said during a press conference on Monday, October 19, that the provincial legislative body received the budget endorsement from the executive department on Wednesday, October 14. However, that missed the cutoff for inclusion in Monday’s session agenda. Soco said that the proposed budget would most likely be taken up during the SP session on Monday, October 26. Once […]...
